kappa.label: kappa
kappa.description: Odd central extension parameter for inhomogeneous deformation; acts trivially on g

K.label: K
K.description: Central identity element; identified with scalar 1 and excluded from PBW basis

basis.ordering_convention: PBW: kappa < [odd: Mode Block (eps1_del{k}_pp/pm/mp/mm)] < [even: Cartan, Long roots, Short roots] (K = 1 is excluded)

references: Frappat et al. (2000), Dictionary on Lie Algebras and Superalgebras
